description: Create an FTP account (login user@domain) for a domain on GlobalHostia hosting, with access to the domain's folder (default) or to public_ftp. A strong random password is set and never shown; the customer sets their own in the control panel before use.

domain.description: A domain on your account, e.g. mybrand.com

folder.description: domain = the domain's website folder (default), ftp = public_ftp

user.description: User part of the login, e.g. "designer"

name: create_ftp_user
title: Create an FTP account
